> Action items for our side: Laura/Marissa/Ben — can you confirm: (1) whether we should instruct customers to send OUR vs SHA vs BEN for correspondent fees, (2) the preferred beneficiary account for EUR and USD remits, and (3) VAT guidance for EU B2B where a VAT ID is provided?

Short answers / recommended default:
- Fee ownership: default to OUR (payer covers all fees) for non-US cross-border wires. That reduces shortfalls and reconciliation overhead. We can accept SHA only if customer has a billing/treasury policy that mandates it, but then we need a reserve/shortfall process.
- Accounts: prefer EUR -> nostro (EuroClear Bank / IBAN GB33EURO00001234567890) ; USD -> Redwood Inference LLC, Chase NY (ABA: 021000021, SWIFT: CHASUS33) — include beneficiary name + account number.
- VAT: for B2B EU customers, if they provide a valid VAT ID we apply reverse charge (no VAT on our invoice). If no VAT ID, charge local VAT at the rate per invoice (we currently default to 20% where applicable).

Marissa — please confirm the specific correspondent bank name/code we should provide for EUR rails (Ben/ops will confirm). Also attach the 1‑page guidance we send to customers when they are paying from emerging markets (intermediary fees are common).

-Laura

Intermediary/Correspondent bank (if required):

SWIFT: EUXCGB2L
Clearing details: For credit to CHASUS33 (final settlement via Chase NY)

Operational notes:
- Ask payers to use OUR if possible. That will avoid deductions taken by intermediary banks and prevents underpayments.
- If customer insists on SHA, include a margin check: if the payment arrives short, our billing team will invoice the shortfall within 3 business days and the customer must remit the difference.
- For FX: if the payer wires in EUR but our account is USD and the bank does FX, intermediary fees + conversion spread may be applied by the correspondent. If the payer wants to avoid double conversion, recommend sending to our EUR IBAN when doing EUR payments.

I’ve attached the customer-facing collection instructions template (collection_instructions_template.docx) — Jordan, feel free to forward a tailored version to Maria.
